stages.headline: Two equations are equivalent if they have the same solutions; systems with the same solutions are also equivalent.
stages.headlineEnglish: Two equations are equivalent if they have the same solutions; systems with the same solutions are also equivalent.

stages.headline: Equivalent moves: multiply both sides by a non-zero number, move a term across changing its sign, add one equation of a system to another.
stages.headlineEnglish: Equivalent moves: multiply both sides by a non-zero number, move a term across changing its sign, add one equation of a system to another.

stages.headline: All solving steps are equivalent moves, so the final system's solution is the original one's.
stages.headlineEnglish: All solving steps are equivalent moves, so the final system's solution is the original one's.
